name: licensing-board-structured-decisions
description: Solve State Licensing Board / regulatory "structured decision" tasks that ask for a JSON answer conforming to a provided input/payloads/answer_template.json, built by reading a licensing data service (policies/rules plus contractor, liquor, or alcohol-renewal datasets, usually with a read-only SQL endpoint). Use for contractor batch eligibility reviews, restricted liquor-license staff packages, and alcohol renewal manual-review queues. Triggers: a prompt that assigns a licensing-examiner / staff-review role, lists GET endpoints under /api/... plus an answer template, and asks for determinations, deficiency/risk codes, control/obligation codes, verification gaps, monitoring plans, or a ranked review queue.
